title: Value-Rectified Distillation for Flow-based Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.29075v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We aim to address the problem of Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Mode Averaging, a critical problem that emerges when distilling Flow Matching (FM) based behavior policies in offline Reinforcement Learning (RL): When learning over multi-modal datasets, standard distillation inadvertently forces the policy to interpolate across different behavioral modes, causing the generated actions to collapse into invalid, OOD regions. To resolve this, we propose Value-Rectified Distillation (VRD), a novel framework that reformulates offline policy distillation as a value-guided generative trajectory alignment problem. By employing a dynamic coupling mechanism, VRD actively rectifies flow dynamics to explicitly decouple distinct behavioral modes, cleanly isolating high-value actions. Specifically, we instantiate VRD through two complementary algorithms: VRD-Q, which utilizes value-quantile behavior distillation to statistically filter out low-value behavior

translated_title: 面向基于流的离线强化学习的价值校正蒸馏
translated_abstract: 我们旨在解决分布外（OOD）模态平均问题，这是在离线强化学习（RL）中蒸馏基于流匹配（FM）的行为策略时出现的一个关键问题：在多模态数据集上学习时，标准蒸馏会无意中迫使策略在不同行为模态之间进行插值，导致生成的动作坍缩到无效的分布外区域。为解决这一问题，我们提出价值校正蒸馏（VRD），这是一个将离线策略蒸馏重新表述为价值引导的生成式轨迹对齐问题的新颖框架。通过采用动态耦合机制，VRD主动校正流动力学，以显式解耦不同的行为模态，从而干净地分离出高价值动作。具体而言，我们通过两种互补算法来实例化VRD：其中VRD-Q利用价值分位数行为蒸馏从统计上过滤掉低价值行为
tldr: 提出价值校正蒸馏（VRD）框架，将离线策略蒸馏重新表述为价值引导的生成式轨迹对齐问题，通过动态耦合机制校正流动力学以解耦多模态行为并分离高价值动作，从而解决离线强化学习中的分布外模态平均问题。
en_tdlr: Value-Rectified Distillation (VRD) addresses OOD mode averaging in offline RL by reformulating policy distillation as value-guided generative trajectory alignment, using a dynamic coupling mechanism to rectify flow dynamics, decouple behavioral modes, and isolate high-value actions.
